nodes.label: setup()
nodes.desc: Public setup() loads setup_requires, then delegates to distutils.core.setup which was monkeypatched to the setuptools Distribution.

nodes.label: _BuildMetaBackend
nodes.desc: PEP 517 backend hooks: build_wheel, build_sdist, build_editable, get_requires_*; module-level bindings at the file tail.

nodes.label: Distribution
nodes.desc: setuptools.dist.Distribution subclasses the distutils base, adds _DISTUTILS_UNSUPPORTED_METADATA fields, config parsing, and pluggable command resolution.

nodes.label: pyprojecttoml
nodes.desc: Reads and validates [project] tables from pyproject.toml via a JSON schema, then applies them to the Distribution.

nodes.label: setupcfg
nodes.desc: Parses setup.cfg sections through ConfigMetadataHandler / ConfigOptionsHandler with deprecation-aware key normalization.

nodes.label: command registry
nodes.desc: Package import side-effects register the 'egg' format into distutils bdist.format_commands.

nodes.label: egg_info
nodes.desc: Writes PKG-INFO, entry_points.txt, requires.txt and SOURCES.txt; the pivot of every metadata request.

nodes.label: editable_wheel
nodes.desc: PEP 660 editable installs with strict/lenient/compat modes backed by .pth files, link trees and a top-level finder template.

nodes.label: bdist_wheel
nodes.desc: Wheel builder using tag computation from vendored packaging and WheelFile from the vendored wheel library.

nodes.label: distutils Distribution
nodes.desc: The local copy of distutils that ships inside setuptools; base class of setuptools' own Distribution.

nodes.label: distutils setup()
nodes.desc: setup() and run_setup(): builds a Distribution from attrs and dispatches command sequences.

nodes.label: patch_all
nodes.desc: Swaps distutils.core.Command, Distribution and Extension for the setuptools variants at import time.
